card.name: Words before a size or amount limit
card.fires_on: Words that come just before a numeric threshold or qualifier, such as 'with' before a contract value, 'weight' or 'water' before 'less/larger than', and digits inside ranges. Also partway through drug names like ribavirin and sofosbuvir.

modes.label: Before a threshold
modes.description: A noun or 'with' that is followed by a quantity limit or amount.
modes.example: Prohibits employment discrimination by employers<< with>> Federal contracts or subcontracts of $2

modes.label: Inside numeric ranges
modes.description: A digit inside a range or cutoff in a table or dosing list.

modes.label: Inside antiviral or dosing names
modes.description: Middle pieces of drug names or dosing words in pediatric dosing text.
modes.example: Ribav<<ir>>in Oral Solution may be used in any

card.writes: It nudges the output toward words for estimated amounts, such as value, turnover, weight and water volume.
card.plain: It fires on words that set up a size, weight or amount cutoff, and on some drug name pieces.
